UPDATE APP_CAEDM.DW_ETL_AUDIT
SET STATUS='E',
	END_DTM=GETDATE()
 WHERE
	STATUS='I'
	AND
	ID = (SELECT MAX(ID) FROM 	APP_CAEDM.DW_ETL_AUDIT WHERE 	ENTITY='DW FACT MEMBER CONCEPT')
	AND
	END_DTM IS NULL
